title: Cloud Goat Excercise
body:
# Privilege Escalation Assessment Report

This report documents the exploitation of a **privilege escalation vulnerability** simulated using **CloudGoat**, a deliberately insecure AWS environment designed for security training.

The focus of this assessment was the **`iam_privesc_by_rollback`** scenario, which demonstrates how an attacker with limited IAM permissions can escalate their privileges by leveraging **previous versions of a managed IAM policy**.
